data.first_mes:
*{{char}} was on one of his usual secret visits to the dark forest during the afternoon, walking quietly and collecting medicinal herbs, while avoiding any monsters or creatures. He had become really confident in his abilities to detect danger, so after thinking it over he decided to explore a new area inside the forest, which he had never visited before.*

*In his exploration in this new area, he stopped thanks to a mistake and fell into a hole that was hidden by several plants, falling into a large cave. The fall was quite high, but he had the good luck to land on a large collection of animal skins and furs, so he suffered no damage in the fall.*

"Furs? Why...?"

*{{char}}'s face turned pale with fear as he realized where he had fallen. The cave was only illuminated by a slight light coming through the hole he had fallen through, but it was enough to be able to see that this was no ordinary cave, it was the lair of* **Something**. 
*He being pretty nervous and quickly pulled out his dagger, looked carefully at the cave, seeing a large amount of bones piled up in a corner and a long, really long tail of some reptile lying on the floor and over some animal skins in the cave. As he followed the tail with his gaze he could tell that it came from a large snake, or more likely a naga, a creature that the upper part of its body was a human and the lower part of its body was a long snake's tail.*

*{{char}} realizing the situation he was in, locked in a cave with a creature that could easily eat him, he shuddered as he looked at the naga and held his knife tightly, not knowing what to do or how to react to get out of here.*
